questions.prompt: What helps you focus when you study?
questions.sampleA1: I study in quiet room. No noise helps me.
questions.sampleA2: When I study, I like to be in a quiet place. I close my door and I don't use my phone. This helps me focus better.
questions.sampleB1: What helps me focus is studying in a quiet environment. I usually go to my room and close the door. Also, I sometimes listen to calm music because it helps me concentrate better. I think it's important not to use your phone while studying.
questions.sampleB2: To be honest, the biggest thing for me is a quiet space with no distractions. I always put away my phone, because otherwise I end up scrolling through social media for hours. I suppose a bit of instrumental music in the background helps me get in the zone, and breaking my work into short chunks keeps me from burning out.
questions.uzSampleA1: Men tinch xonada o'qiyman. Hech qanday shovqin menga yordam beradi.
questions.uzSampleA2: Men o'qiganimda, tinch joyda bo'lishni xohlayman. Men eshigimni yopaman va telefonimdan foydalanmayman. Bu menga yaxshiroq diqqatni jamlashga yordam beradi.
questions.uzSampleB1:
Menga diqqatni jamlashga yordam beradigan narsa – bu tinch muhitda o'qish. Odatda xonamga boraman va eshikni yopaman.
Shuningdek, ba'zida men tinchlantiruvchi musiqa tinglayman, chunki u menga yaxshiroq konsentratsiya qilishga yordam beradi. O'ylashimcha, o'qish paytida telefondan foydalanmaslik muhim.
questions.uzSampleB2:
O'qish paytida diqqatimni jamlashga bir nechta narsa yordam beradi.
Avvalo, menga tartibli ish joyi va minimal shovqin kerak. Instrumental musiqa, ayniqsa klassik yoki lo-fi, meni samarali fikrlashga undaydi.
Bundan tashqari, men Pomodoro texnikasidan foydalanaman - qisqa tanaffuslar bilan 25 daqiqalik diqqat bilan o'qish - bu aqliy charchoqni oldini oladi va diqqatimni o'tkir saqlaydi.

vocabulary.title: Q1 - What helps you focus when you study?
idioms: buckle down - "jiddiy kirishmoq (diqqatni to'plamoq)"
in the zone - "to'liq diqqatda bo'lmoq"
burn the midnight oil - "kechasi uyqusiz qolib ishlash (o'qish)"
sentenceStarters: "The single most effective thing that helps me concentrate is..." - "Diqqatimni jamlashga yordam beradigan eng samarali narsa bu…"
"Additionally, I always make sure to put my phone on silent mode..." - "Bundan tashqari, men doimo telefonimni ovozsiz rejimga qo'yaman…"

questions.sampleAnswer:
The single most effective thing that helps me concentrate is listening to ambient instrumental music. It creates a remarkably calming background that drowns out distracting noises without pulling my attention away from the material.
Additionally, I always make sure to put my phone on silent mode and place it in another room. Eliminating the temptation of social media notifications is absolutely crucial for maintaining my train of thought.
questions.uzSampleAnswer:
Menga diqqatimni jamlashga yordam beradigan eng samarali narsa bu ambient instrumental musiqani tinglashdir. Bu diqqatni chalg'ituvchi shovqinlarni yo'q qiladigan, lekin e'tiborimni materialdan uzoqlashtirmaydigan juda tinchlantiruvchi fon yaratadi.

Bundan tashqari, men har doim telefonimni ovozsiz rejimga qo'yib, uni boshqa xonaga qo'yishga harakat qilaman. Ijtimoiy tarmoqlar bildirishnomalarining vasvasasini yo'qotish, fikrlarim uzluksizligini saqlash uchun juda muhimdir.

questions.prompt: Why do you think learning English is important?
questions.sampleA1: English is important. Many people speak English. I need it for work.
questions.sampleA2: I think English is important because it is used everywhere. Many countries speak English and it helps you communicate with people from other countries.
questions.sampleB1: I believe learning English is very important today. Firstly, it is used in many countries around the world for business and travel. Also, most websites and films are in English. So, if you know English, you can understand a lot more information.
questions.sampleB2: Well, I'd say English is absolutely essential these days. The thing is, it's more or less the global language — you need it for pretty much everything, from browsing the internet to landing a decent job. Personally, learning it has opened up so many doors for me. I honestly can't imagine getting by without it in today's world.
questions.uzSampleA1: Ingliz tili muhim. Ko'p odamlar ingliz tilida gaplashadi. Menga u ish uchun kerak.
questions.uzSampleA2: Menimcha, ingliz tili muhim, chunki u hamma joyda ishlatiladi. Ko'p davlatlar ingliz tilida gaplashadi va u sizga boshqa davlatlardan kelgan odamlar bilan muloqot qilishga yordam beradi.
questions.uzSampleB1:
Menimcha, ingliz tilini o'rganish bugungi kunda juda muhim.
Birinchidan, u dunyoning ko'p mamlakatlarida biznes va sayohat uchun ishlatiladi.
Shuningdek, ko'pgina veb-saytlar va filmlar ingliz tilida. Shunday qilib, agar siz ingliz tilini bilsangiz, siz ko'proq ma'lumotni tushunishingiz mumkin.
questions.uzSampleB2: Ingliz tilini o'rganish, mening fikrimcha, inson o'zining shaxsiy rivojlanishiga kiritishi mumkin bo'lgan eng qimmatli sarmoyalardan biridir. Bu xalqaro tijorat, ilmiy tadqiqotlar va global ommaviy axborot vositalarining asosiy tilidir. Faqatgina kasbiy istiqbollardan tashqari, u sizga juda ko'p ma'lumotlarga kirish va turli madaniyatlardan bo'lgan odamlar bilan bog'lanish imkonini beradi. Tobora globallashayotgan dunyoda ingliz tilini bilish hashamat emas, balki zaruratga aylanib bormoqda.

vocabulary.title: Q2 - Why is learning English important?
idioms: passport to the world - "dunyoga pasport (keng imkoniyatlar kaliti)"
open doors - "eshiklarni ochmoq (imkoniyatlar yaratmoq)"
a stepping stone - "zinapoya pog'onasi (maqsad sari qadam)"
sentenceStarters: "In today's interconnected world, English serves as the undeniably dominant lingua franca..." - "Bugungi o'zaro bog'langan dunyoda ingliz tili shubhasiz xalqaro…"
"Furthermore, the overwhelming majority of online content is published in English..." - "Bundan tashqari, onlayn kontentning asosiy qismi ingliz tilida nashr etiladi…"

questions.sampleAnswer:
In today's interconnected world, English serves as the undeniably dominant lingua franca of international business, academia, and diplomacy. Mastering it opens doors to a vast array of career opportunities that would otherwise remain inaccessible.
Furthermore, the overwhelming majority of online content — from scientific research papers to entertainment — is published in English. Without it, one is essentially locked out of a massive knowledge repository. Learning English is not just a skill; it is a "passport to the world."
questions.uzSampleAnswer:
Bugungi o'zaro bog'langan dunyoda, ingliz tili xalqaro biznes, akademiya va diplomatiyaning shubhasiz ustun lingua francasi bo'lib xizmat qiladi. Uni o'zlashtirish, aks holda erishib bo'lmaydigan ko'plab kasbiy imkoniyatlar eshiklarini ochadi.

Bundan tashqari, onlayn kontentning katta qismi - ilmiy tadqiqotlardan tortib, ko'ngilochar dasturlargacha - ingliz tilida nashr etiladi. Usiz, odam, asosan, ulkan bilimlar omboridan mahrum bo'ladi. Ingliz tilini o'rganish shunchaki mahorat emas; bu "dunyoga yo'llanma".

questions.prompt: What do you usually buy when you go shopping?
questions.sampleA1: I buy food. Bread, milk, fruit. Sometimes I buy clothes.
questions.sampleA2: When I go shopping, I usually buy food like bread, eggs, and fruits. Sometimes I buy new shoes or a T-shirt if I need one.
questions.sampleB1: When I go shopping, I usually buy food and things for the house. For example, I often buy rice, vegetables, and cleaning products. However, sometimes I also look at clothes or electronics if there is a sale.
questions.sampleB2: Honestly, most of the time I just buy the essentials — groceries, toiletries, that sort of thing. I try to stick to a list so I don't splash out on things I don't really need. That said, every now and then I'll treat myself to a new book or a nice pair of trainers if I've had a good month. I'm quite a careful spender.
questions.uzSampleA1: Men oziq-ovqat sotib olaman. Non, sut, meva. Ba'zan kiyim ham sotib olaman.
questions.uzSampleA2: Men xaridga borganimda, odatda non, tuxum va mevalar kabi oziq-ovqat mahsulotlarini sotib olaman. Ba'zida, agar kerak bo'lsa, yangi poyabzal yoki futbolka sotib olaman.
questions.uzSampleB1:
Men xaridga borganimda, odatda oziq-ovqat va uy uchun narsalar sotib olaman.
Masalan, men ko'pincha guruch, sabzavotlar va tozalash vositalarini sotib olaman.
Biroq, ba'zida men kiyim-kechak yoki elektronika mahsulotlariga ham qarayman, agar chegirma bo'lsa.
questions.uzSampleB2: Mening xarid qilish odatlarim asosan amaliy zaruratlar atrofida shakllangan. Men odatda har hafta oziq-ovqat va uy-ro'zg'or buyumlarini sotib olaman. Shunga qaramay, vaqti-vaqti bilan men o'ylab ko'rilgan xaridlarni ham qilaman, masalan, o'qishni xohlagan kitobim yoki yangi gadjet. Men ongli iste'molchi bo'lishga harakat qilaman va chinakam ehtiyojim bo'lmagan narsalarni sotib olishdan qochaman.

vocabulary.title: Q3 - What do you usually buy when shopping?
idioms: shop till you drop - "toliqquningcha xarid qilmoq"
window shopping - "ko'z-ko'z bilan ko'rib yurish (sotib olmasdan qarash)"
break the bank - "hamyonni bo'shatmoq (juda ko'p pul sarflamoq)"
sentenceStarters: "When I go shopping, I predominantly purchase everyday essentials such as..." - "Xarid qilishga borganimda, men asosan kundalik zaruriy narsalarni sotib olaman, masalan…"
"Occasionally, however, I do treat myself to something special..." - "Ba'zan, biroq, men o'zimga alohida biror narsa ravo ko'raman…"

questions.sampleAnswer:
When I go shopping, I predominantly purchase everyday essentials such as groceries, fresh produce, and household items. I am quite a practical shopper; I always prepare a detailed list beforehand to avoid impulse purchases.
Occasionally, however, I do treat myself to something special — perhaps a new book or a piece of clothing that catches my eye. I believe in maintaining a balance between being financially prudent and "rewarding yourself" for hard work.
questions.uzSampleAnswer:
Men xaridga borganimda, asosan, oziq-ovqat, yangi meva-sabzavotlar va uy-ro'zg'or buyumlari kabi kundalik zarur narsalarni sotib olaman. Men juda amaliy xaridorman; men doimo oldindan batafsil ro'yxat tuzaman, shunda beixtiyor xaridlardan qochaman.

Ba'zida, lekin, men o'zimni maxsus narsa bilan siylayman - ehtimol, yangi kitob yoki ko'zimni tortadigan biror kiyim. Men moliyaviy jihatdan tejamkor bo'lish va qattiq mehnat uchun "o'zingizni mukofotlash" o'rtasida muvozanatni saqlashga ishonaman.

questions.prompt: Describe what is happening in each photo.
questions.sampleA1: First picture — old building. Workers fix it. Second picture — big new building. Glass. Very tall.
questions.sampleA2: In the first picture, I see an old building. People are repairing it. In the second picture, there is a very tall, modern building made of glass. It looks very new and shiny.
questions.sampleB1: The first photo shows an old building that is being repaired or restored. I can see that it is a historical building because of its style. On the other hand, the second photo shows a very modern skyscraper made of glass. It looks very new and impressive. The two buildings are very different.
questions.sampleB2: So, in the first photo, a group of workers in hi-vis vests and hard hats are dangling from ropes as they carefully restore the facade of a grand old building. You can see the ornate stonework and wrought-iron balconies, so it's clearly a historical one they're doing up. The second picture, on the other hand, shows a modern glass skyscraper going up, with huge cranes lifting up glass panels. The contrast is striking — one is all about preserving the past, while the other is reaching for the future.
questions.uzSampleA1: Birinchi rasm — eski bino. Ishchilar uni tuzatmoqda. Ikkinchi rasm — katta yangi bino. Shisha. Juda baland.
questions.uzSampleA2:
Birinchi rasmda men eski binoni ko'ryapman. Odamlar uni ta'mirlashyapti.
Ikkinchi rasmda juda baland, shishadan yasalgan zamonaviy bino bor. U juda yangi va yaltiroq ko'rinadi.
questions.uzSampleB1:
Birinchi suratda ta'mirlanayotgan yoki restavratsiya qilinayotgan eski bino ko'rsatilgan. Men uning uslubidan kelib chiqib, bu tarixiy bino ekanligini ko'rishim mumkin.
Boshqa tomondan, ikkinchi suratda shishadan yasalgan juda zamonaviy osmono'par bino ko'rsatilgan. U juda yangi va ta'sirli ko'rinadi. Ikki bino juda farqli.
questions.uzSampleB2:
Birinchi rasmda tarixiy ahamiyatga ega bo'lgan binoning restavratsiyasi tasvirlangan. Arxitektura uslubi uning bir necha o'n yillar, balki asrlar oldin qurilganligini ko'rsatadi va uning asl xususiyatini saqlab qolish uchun katta kuch sarflanmoqda.
Aksincha, ikkinchi rasmda zamonaviy arxitektura tendentsiyalarini o'zida mujassam etgan hayratlanarli, zamonaviy shisha osmono'par bino tasvirlangan. Ikkalasining o'rtasidagi farq juda kuchli — biri merosni saqlash qadriyatini ifodalasa, ikkinchisi taraqqiyot va innovatsiyalarni anglatadi.

vocabulary.title: Q4 - Describe the photos
idioms: stand the test of time - "vaqt sinoviga dosh bermoq"
a blast from the past - "o'tmishdan esdalik"
out with the old, in with the new - "eskini chiqar, yangisini keltir"
sentenceStarters: "The first photograph captures an old historical building that is currently undergoing careful restoration..." - "Birinchi fotosuratda ehtiyotkorlik bilan ta'mirlanayotgan qadimiy tarixiy bino tasvirlangan…"
"In sharp contrast, the second image showcases a futuristic glass skyscraper..." - "Bunga keskin qarama-qarshi o'laroq, ikkinchi rasmda kelajak uslubidagi shisha osmono'par bino…"

questions.sampleAnswer:
The first photograph captures an old historical building that is currently undergoing careful restoration. Workers or scaffolding can be seen around the structure, suggesting a meticulous effort to preserve its original architectural grandeur while reinforcing its structural integrity.
In sharp contrast, the second image showcases a futuristic glass skyscraper — a symbol of modern urban development. Its sleek, reflective facade represents the cutting-edge design philosophy of contemporary architecture. Together, the two images beautifully juxtapose tradition and modernity in the urban landscape.
questions.uzSampleAnswer:
Birinchi suratda ehtiyotkorlik bilan ta'mirlanayotgan eski tarixiy bino aks etgan. Strukturani o'rab turgan ishchilar yoki iskala ko'rinib turibdi, bu uning asl arxitektura ulug'vorligini saqlab qolish va uning strukturaviy yaxlitligini mustahkamlash uchun puxta harakat qilinayotganini ko'rsatadi.

Keskin farq sifatida, ikkinchi rasmda futuristik shisha osmono'par bino - zamonaviy shaharsozlik ramzi namoyish etilgan. Uning silliq, aks ettiruvchi fasadi zamonaviy arxitekturaning ilg'or dizayn falsafasini ifodalaydi. Ikkala rasm birgalikda shahar landshaftida an'ana va zamonaviylikni chiroyli tarzda yonma-yon qo'yadi.

questions.prompt: What are the benefits of preserving old historical buildings in a modern city?
questions.sampleA1: Old buildings are good. They are beautiful. People like to see them. History is important.
questions.sampleA2: I think old buildings are important because they show us history. Tourists like to visit them and take photos. Also, they make the city look more interesting.
questions.sampleB1: There are several benefits to keeping old buildings. Firstly, they are part of our history, and we can learn about the past from them. Also, tourists often come to see historical buildings, which is good for the economy. However, it can be expensive to maintain them.
questions.sampleB2: Well, to my mind, old buildings give a city its sense of identity. They're a link to the past, so they remind people of their history and roots. On top of that, they tend to draw in tourists, which gives the local economy a proper boost. I suppose the mix of old and new also stops a city from turning into a dull concrete jungle.
questions.uzSampleA1: Eski binolar yaxshi. Ular chiroyli. Odamlar ularni ko'rishni xohlashadi. Tarix muhim.
questions.uzSampleA2: Menimcha, eski binolar muhim, chunki ular bizga tarixni ko'rsatadi. Sayyohlar ularni ziyorat qilishni va suratga olishni yaxshi ko'radilar. Bundan tashqari, ular shaharni yanada qiziqarliroq ko'rsatadi.
questions.uzSampleB1: Eski binolarni saqlab qolishning bir nechta foydasi bor. Birinchidan, ular bizning tariximizning bir qismi va biz ulardan o'tmish haqida bilib olishimiz mumkin. Shuningdek, sayyohlar ko'pincha tarixiy binolarni ko'rishga kelishadi, bu esa iqtisodiyot uchun yaxshi. Biroq, ularni saqlash qimmatga tushishi mumkin.
questions.uzSampleB2:
Tarixiy binolarni saqlab qolish zamonaviy shahar uchun ko'plab afzalliklarni taqdim etadi.
Avvalo, ular shaharga o'ziga xos xususiyat va joy tuyg'usini beradigan madaniy diqqatga sazovor joylar bo'lib xizmat qiladi. Bu madaniy meros ta'lim uchun va jamiyat g'ururini rivojlantirish uchun bebaho hisoblanadi.
Bundan tashqari, iqtisodiy nuqtai nazardan, yaxshi ta'mirlangan tarixiy joylar turizmni kuchli harakatlantiruvchi omil hisoblanadi.
Bundan tashqari, eski va yangi inshootlarni aralashtirish natijasida yaratilgan me'moriy xilma-xillik shaharlarni yanada estetik jihatdan qiziqarli va yashashga qulay qiladi.

vocabulary.title: Q5 - Benefits of preserving old buildings
idioms: remember where you came from - "qayerdan kelganingni unutmaslik (ildizlaringni bilish)"
set in stone - "o'zgarmas (toshga o'yilgan)"
built to last - "uzoq muddat xizmat qiladigan qilib qurilgan"
sentenceStarters: "Preserving historical buildings in modern cities offers a multitude of profoundly important benefits..." - "Zamonaviy shaharlarda tarixiy binolarni saqlash juda ko'p muhim afzalliklarni taqdim etadi…"
"Moreover, restored heritage buildings often become major tourist attractions..." - "Bundan tashqari, ta'mirlangan meros binolari ko'pincha asosiy turistik diqqatga sazovor joylarga aylanadi…"

questions.sampleAnswer:
Preserving historical buildings in modern cities offers a multitude of profoundly important benefits. First and foremost, these structures serve as tangible links to our collective past. They tell the story of previous generations, their aesthetics, engineering prowess, and cultural values. Without them, a city risks losing its unique identity and becoming a generic concrete landscape.
Moreover, restored heritage buildings often become major tourist attractions, generating significant revenue for the local economy. Cities like Rome, Istanbul, and Samarkand thrive precisely because of their preserved historical cores.
Finally, blending old and new architecture creates a visually stunning and culturally rich urban environment. It allows citizens to "remember where they came from" while striding confidently into the future.
questions.uzSampleAnswer:
Zamonaviy shaharlarda tarixiy binolarni saqlab qolish juda muhim afzalliklarni taqdim etadi. Avvalo, bu inshootlar bizning umumiy o'tmishimiz bilan sezilarli bog'lovchi vazifasini o'taydi. Ular avvalgi avlodlarning hikoyasini, ularning estetikasi, muhandislik mahorati va madaniy qadriyatlarini so'zlab beradi. Ularsiz shahar o'ziga xosligini yo'qotish va umumiy beton landshaftga aylanish xavfini tug'diradi.
Qolaversa, ta'mirlangan meros binolari ko'pincha asosiy sayyohlik diqqatga sazovor joylariga aylanadi va mahalliy iqtisodiyot uchun sezilarli daromad keltiradi. Rim, Istanbul va Samarqand kabi shaharlar aynan saqlanib qolingan tarixiy markazlari tufayli gullab-yashnamoqda.
Nihoyat, eski va yangi arxitekturaning uyg'unligi vizual jihatdan hayratlanarli va madaniy jihatdan boy shahar muhitini yaratadi. Bu fuqarolarga kelajakka ishonch bilan qadam qo'yish bilan birga "qayerdan kelganliklarini eslash" imkonini beradi.

questions.prompt: Why do some people prefer living in modern glass buildings instead of traditional ones?
questions.sampleA1: New buildings are good. They have everything. Old buildings are sometimes cold. Glass buildings are nice.
questions.sampleA2: Some people prefer modern buildings because they are new and clean. They have lifts and parking. Also, they have big windows with nice views.
questions.sampleB1: Many people prefer modern glass buildings because they look very nice and have a lot of facilities. For example, they often have gyms, security systems, and modern kitchens. Also, they are usually warmer in winter because they have good heating. Traditional buildings can be cold and don't always have these things.
questions.sampleB2: I suppose the main draw is comfort and convenience. Modern glass towers usually come with all the mod cons — lifts, underground parking, smart heating, you name it. On top of that, they're more energy efficient and they let in loads of natural light. And to be honest, for a lot of people, living high up with a panoramic view is quite a status symbol.
questions.uzSampleA1: Yangi binolar yaxshi. Ularda hamma narsa bor. Eski binolar ba'zan sovuq bo'ladi. Shisha binolar chiroyli.
questions.uzSampleA2: Ba'zi odamlar zamonaviy binolarni afzal ko'rishadi, chunki ular yangi va toza. Ularda liftlar va avtoturargohlar bor. Shuningdek, ularda chiroyli manzarali katta derazalar mavjud.
questions.uzSampleB1:
Ko'p odamlar zamonaviy shisha binolarni afzal ko'rishadi, chunki ular juda chiroyli ko'rinadi va ko'plab qulayliklarga ega.
Masalan, ularda ko'pincha sport zallari, xavfsizlik tizimlari va zamonaviy oshxonalar bo'ladi.
Shuningdek, ular odatda qishda issiqroq bo'ladi, chunki ularda yaxshi isitish tizimi mavjud. An'anaviy binolar sovuq bo'lishi mumkin va har doim ham bunday narsalarga ega emas.
questions.uzSampleB2:
Zamonaviy shisha binolarning jozibadorligi ko'p qirrali.
Birinchidan, ular eski binolar oddiygina ta'minlay olmaydigan qulaylik va qulaylik darajasini taklif etadi - aqlli uy texnologiyalari va samarali iqlim nazoratidan tortib, keng, ochiq rejadagi yashash joylarigacha.
Ikkinchidan, zamonaviy binoning estetikasi, o'zining toza chiziqlari va keng derazalari bilan minimalist, zamonaviy turmush tarzini qadrlaydigan odamlarga yoqadi.
Bundan tashqari, intilish elementi ham bor; zamonaviy minorada yashash ko'pincha professional muvaffaqiyat va kelajakka intiluvchan mentalitet bilan bog'liq.

vocabulary.title: Q6 - Preferring modern glass buildings
idioms: keeping up with the Joneses - "qo'shnilardan qolmaslik (obro' uchun musobaqalashish)"
home is where the heart is - "uy — yurak turgan joy"
all mod cons - "barcha zamonaviy qulayliklar (modern conveniences)"
sentenceStarters: "The preference for modern glass buildings is driven by several highly practical considerations..." - "Zamonaviy shisha binolarga afzallik berish bir qancha juda amaliy sabablar bilan…"
"Furthermore, modern buildings typically come equipped with amenities like..." - "Bundan tashqari, zamonaviy binolar odatda … kabi qulayliklar bilan jihozlangan."

questions.sampleAnswer:
The preference for modern glass buildings is driven by several highly practical considerations. Primarily, these structures are designed with state-of-the-art technology, offering superior energy efficiency, smart home features, and contemporary layouts that maximize space and natural light.
Furthermore, modern buildings typically come equipped with amenities like underground parking, gyms, and high-speed lifts, which cater to the fast-paced lifestyle of urban professionals. They represent a sense of upward mobility and progress.
Lastly, for many, living in a sleek skyscraper with panoramic city views is the ultimate status symbol. While a traditional building has charm, a modern tower whispers "success."
questions.uzSampleAnswer:
Zamonaviy shisha binolarni afzal ko'rish bir qator juda amaliy mulohazalar bilan bog'liq. Asosan, bu inshootlar eng zamonaviy texnologiyalar bilan loyihalashtirilgan bo'lib, yuqori energiya samaradorligi, aqlli uy funksiyalari va makon va tabiiy yorug'likni maksimal darajada oshiradigan zamonaviy rejalarni taklif etadi.

Bundan tashqari, zamonaviy binolar odatda yer osti avtoturargohlari, sport zallari va yuqori tezlikdagi liftlar kabi qulayliklar bilan jihozlangan bo'lib, ular shahar mutaxassislarining tez sur'atlar bilan rivojlanayotgan turmush tarziga mos keladi. Ular yuqori ijtimoiy mavqega ko'tarilish va taraqqiyot tuyg'usini ifodalaydi.

Va nihoyat, ko'pchilik uchun shahar manzarasi aks etgan zamonaviy osmono'par binoda yashash eng yuqori maqom belgisidir. An'anaviy binoning o'ziga xos jozibasi bo'lsa-da, zamonaviy minora "muvaffaqiyat" deb shivirlaydi.

I still remember how genuinely grateful everyone was — it really put things into perspective for me. As for how it changed my outlook, well, it was a proper wake-up call. I suppose I'd always taken little things like a warm bed and a hot meal completely for granted. After that day, I stopped moaning about trivial problems and started counting my blessings. It also made me far more empathetic towards people who are going through tough times, and I've carried on volunteering ever since, whenever I get the chance. And the thing is, I genuinely believe society should do more to encourage this kind of thing. When people look out for one another, it strengthens community spirit and slowly chips away at inequality. Kindness has a bit of a ripple effect — one good deed inspires the next, and before you know it, the whole neighbourhood benefits. At the end of the day, I think a community that pulls together is a far happier and healthier place to live.

bulletPoints: Describe a time you volunteered to help your community or a person in need.
How did this experience change your perspective on life?
Why is it important for society to promote a culture of kindness and volunteering?
questions.sampleAnswer:
A time I volunteered:
Last winter, I participated in a local charity drive organized to distribute warm clothing and food packages to homeless individuals in our city. I spent an entire Saturday morning sorting donations, packing boxes, and personally handing supplies to people at a local shelter. Seeing the genuine gratitude on their faces was an incredibly humbling experience.
How it changed my perspective:
This experience profoundly shifted my worldview. I realized how easily one can take basic necessities like warm food and shelter for granted. It instilled in me a deep sense of social responsibility and made me far more empathetic towards people facing hardship. I stopped complaining about trivial inconveniences and started appreciating the "little things" in my own life.
Why society should promote kindness and volunteering:
Promoting a culture of volunteering is fundamentally crucial for building a cohesive, compassionate society. When citizens actively help one another, it strengthens social bonds and reduces inequality. Furthermore, volunteering creates a ripple effect: one act of kindness inspires another, gradually transforming the entire community's ethos. It proves that collective goodwill is far more powerful than individual ambition.
questions.uzSampleAnswer:
Men ko'ngilli bo'lgan vaqt:
O'tgan qishda men shahrimizdagi uysiz odamlarga issiq kiyim va oziq-ovqat paketlarini tarqatish uchun tashkil etilgan mahalliy xayriya aksiyasida ishtirok etdim. Butun shanba kuni ertalab xayriyalarni saralash, qutilarni qadoqlash va mahalliy boshpanada odamlarga shaxsan o'zim yordam berish bilan o'tkazdim. Ularning yuzlaridagi chinakam minnatdorchilikni ko'rish juda ham kamtarona tajriba edi.
Bu mening dunyoqarashimni qanday o'zgartirdi:
Bu tajriba mening dunyoqarashimni juda ham chuqur o'zgartirdi. Men issiq ovqat va boshpana kabi asosiy ehtiyojlarni qanchalik oson qabul qilish mumkinligini angladim. Bu menda ijtimoiy mas'uliyatning chuqur tuyg'usini uyg'otdi va qiyinchiliklarga duch kelgan odamlarga nisbatan ancha hamdard bo'lishimga sabab bo'ldi. Men mayda noqulayliklardan shikoyat qilishni to'xtatdim va o'z hayotimdagi "kichik narsalar"ni qadrlay boshladim.
Nega jamiyat mehribonlik va ko'ngillilikni targ'ib qilishi kerak:
Ko'ngillilik madaniyatini targ'ib qilish, ahil va rahmdil jamiyat qurish uchun juda ham muhim. Fuqarolar bir-biriga faol yordam berishganda, bu ijtimoiy aloqalarni mustahkamlaydi va tengsizlikni kamaytiradi. Bundan tashqari, ko'ngillilik to'lqin effekti yaratadi: bitta mehribonlik harakati boshqasini ilhomlantiradi va asta-sekin butun jamiyatning axloqini o'zgartiradi. Bu jamoaviy ezgulik individual ambitsiyalardan ancha kuchli ekanligini isbotlaydi.

questions.prompt: Cities should build more green spaces.
questions.sampleA1: Parks are good. Trees clean air. People walk there. But parks cost money. Not everyone goes to parks.
questions.sampleA2: I think cities should have more parks because people can walk and play there. Parks are good for health. But building parks is expensive and some people don't go to parks.
questions.sampleB1: I think cities should build more green spaces. Parks are great for relaxation and exercise. For example, people can go jogging or play sports. Also, trees help clean the air. However, building parks costs a lot of money, and the land could be used for houses or shops instead.
questions.sampleB2: Well, this is definitely a topic I feel fairly strongly about, and on the whole I'm all for it. On the one hand, the benefits of green spaces are hard to argue with. For a start, parks and gardens do wonders for people's mental well-being — there's plenty of research showing that a bit of greenery helps people unwind and de-stress after a hectic day, which matters more than ever in our fast-paced lives. On top of that, trees soak up pollution and help cool cities down, which is a real bonus given how bad urban heat is getting. And of course, green spaces encourage people to get outdoors, whether that's jogging, cycling, or just catching up with friends. That said, I can see why some people have reservations. The thing is, building and maintaining parks doesn't come cheap, and cash-strapped councils often have other priorities. There's also the argument that land in a crowded city is like gold dust, so some would say it's better put to use for housing or offices. And to be fair, not everybody actually makes use of parks on a regular basis. Still, when all's said and done, I reckon the long-term payoff outweighs the costs. Healthier, happier residents mean lower healthcare bills down the line, and a city with a bit of nature is simply a nicer place to call home. After all, you simply can't put a price on a green, liveable city. So yes, I'd say councils should absolutely press ahead with more green spaces wherever they can.

questions.sampleAnswer:
The debate over whether cities should invest in more green spaces is increasingly pertinent as urbanization accelerates worldwide. Advocates convincingly argue that parks and gardens are essential for the psychological well-being of city dwellers. Studies consistently show that access to nature significantly reduces stress, anxiety, and depression — acting as a natural antidote to the pressures of urban life.
Furthermore, green spaces play a vital role in combating urban heat islands and improving air quality by absorbing carbon dioxide. They also encourage residents to engage in outdoor activities like jogging and cycling, promoting a healthier lifestyle overall.
However, opponents raise legitimate concerns. Creating and maintaining parks requires substantial public funding. The land used for green spaces could alternatively serve for housing or commercial development — a pressing need in overcrowded cities. Additionally, critics note that not all residents use parks regularly, questioning whether the investment benefits the majority.
In conclusion, while costs are a genuine concern, the long-term health, environmental, and social benefits of green spaces overwhelmingly justify the investment. A city without nature is a city without a "soul."
questions.uzSampleAnswer:
Shaharlar ko'proq yashil hududlarga sarmoya kiritishi kerakmi degan bahs, dunyo bo'ylab urbanizatsiya tezlashgani sari tobora dolzarb bo'lib bormoqda. Himoyachilar bog'lar va xiyobonlar shahar aholisining psixologik farovonligi uchun zarur ekanligini ishonchli tarzda ta'kidlaydilar. Tadqiqotlar shuni ko'rsatadiki, tabiatga kirish imkoniyati stress, tashvish va depressiyani sezilarli darajada kamaytiradi va shahar hayotining bosimiga qarshi tabiiy antidot vazifasini o'taydi.

Bundan tashqari, yashil hududlar karbonat angidridni yutish orqali shahar issiqlik orollariga qarshi kurashishda va havo sifatini yaxshilashda muhim rol o'ynaydi. Ular, shuningdek, aholini yugurish va velosipedda yurish kabi ochiq havoda mashg'ulotlar bilan shug'ullanishga undaydi va umuman sog'lom turmush tarzini targ'ib qiladi.

Biroq, qarshilar qonuniy xavotirlarni uyg'otadilar. Bog'larni yaratish va saqlash sezilarli davlat mablag'larini talab qiladi. Yashil hududlar uchun ishlatiladigan yer, aks holda, gavjum shaharlarda dolzarb ehtiyoj bo'lgan uy-joy yoki tijorat qurilishi uchun xizmat qilishi mumkin. Bundan tashqari, tanqidchilarning ta'kidlashicha, barcha aholi bog'lardan muntazam ravishda foydalanmaydi va investitsiyalar ko'pchilikka foyda keltiradimi degan savolni tug'diradi.

Xulosa qilib aytganda, xarajatlar haqiqiy tashvish bo'lsa-da, yashil hududlarning uzoq muddatli sog'liq, ekologik va ijtimoiy foydalari investitsiyalarni juda oqlaydi. Tabiat bo'lmagan shahar - "ruhsiz" shahardir.
